title: Arthas Menethil as the Lich King
description: A dramatic portrayal of Arthas Menethil as the Lich King, standing on a frozen throne in a dark, icy realm. He wears a spiked, black-and-silver armor adorned with skulls, and a long, tattered cape flows behind him. The legendary sword Frostmourne is in his hand, its blade intricately engraved and emanating a cold blue glow. Snow and icy winds swirl around him, adding to the foreboding atmosphere.
generation_prompt: Arthas Menethil as the Lich King, in spiked black-and-silver armor with skulls, standing on a frozen throne in a dark, icy realm. Holding Frostmourne, sword glowing blue. Snow and icy winds swirl around, creating a foreboding atmosphere.
